description: The first official release of UtilityCraft: Digital Storage brings scalable storage networks, centralized item access, integrated crafting and automation for millions of items.
highlights:
- Build scalable digital storage networks with searchable Storage and Crafting Terminals.
- Expand capacity with Storage Cells up to 409,600 items each and up to 16 Cells per Drive.
- Automate transfers with Import and Export Buffers plus the Storage Transfer Station.
- Added third-party Storage Cell registration, UtilityCraft Crafter integration and Vibrant Visuals support.
- Improved network recovery feedback and prevented invalid Item Conduit connections.
